findings.evidence: `stdComplexSymplecticForm_apply` is tagged `@[simp]` at lines 80-82, while the diagonal formula at lines 87-90 and associated metric formula at lines 130-134 have no automation annotation.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to both lemmas, or add equivalent simp-normal-form lemmas for `ω z (J z)` and `ω.associatedBilinForm J z w`.
findings.issue: `stdComplexSymplecticForm_apply_ofComplexModule_self` and `stdComplexSymplecticForm_associatedBilinForm` are characteristic coordinate normal forms for the standard compatible triple, but neither is tagged `@[simp]`.

summary: The exposed complex-line form has the right characteristic formulas, but two normal-form coordinate lemmas are missing simp annotations, so downstream metric/positivity computations do not normalize automatically.
